name: cisco-meraki-mcp
description: Every Meraki Dashboard operation, plus cross-org fleet views, complete pagination, and a local mirror built for MSPs running many client orgs.

meraki_dashboard_api_key.title: Meraki Dashboard API key
meraki_dashboard_api_key.description: Meraki Dashboard API key (Dashboard > My profile > API access). It carries the permissions of the admin who generated it, in every organization that admin can see; generate it from a read-only admin for reporting.

cisco_meraki_base_url.title: Regional dashboard API URL
cisco_meraki_base_url.description: Leave blank for the global dashboard (https://api.meraki.com/api/v1). Set only for a regional dashboard: https://api.meraki.ca/api/v1 (Canada), https://api.meraki.cn/api/v1 (China), https://api.meraki.in/api/v1 (India), https://api.gov-meraki.com/api/v1 (FedRAMP).

cisco_meraki_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only mode
cisco_meraki_mcp_read_only.description: Set to 1 to make the MCP server refuse every write: only GET endpoints are callable and fleet push --apply is refused. Secret-bearing GETs (SSID pre-shared keys, SNMP community strings) still return data. Leave blank to allow writes.

cisco_meraki_base_path.title: API base path
cisco_meraki_base_path.description: API path appended to the global host. Leave blank for api/v1; ignored when CISCO_MERAKI_BASE_URL is set.

cisco_meraki_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
cisco_meraki_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Meraki requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's built-in User-Agent.

cisco_meraki_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
cisco_meraki_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
